findings.label: Search field height no longer pinned
findings.detail: The old search was a fixed height:52 Container; the new TextField sizes from appFieldDecoration + contentPadding(vertical:15) and relies on the Row's default center cross-alignment against the 52px IconSquareButton filter. Debounce, clear suffix, prefix, hint, and TextInputAction.search are all preserved and the field is inside Expanded so no overflow. Likely fine visually, but not height-matched by construction; a single visual glance at the Transactions header would confirm alignment. Not blocking.
